findings.title: Timed-out releases can outlive their claims and invalidate a subsequent seal
findings.detail: FIXED. The provider release names both generation and metageneration. Lines 101–110 re-observe a failed precondition and require successful claim rebasing before another release. packages/persistence/src/source/holds.ts:267 restricts rebasing to the latest unanswered live claim; migration 0020_source_object_holds.sql:350 rejects expired claims. The fake checks both provider preconditions at packages/application/src/testing/contract-fake-object-storage.ts:551 before clearing the hold. apps/control/test/seal-holds.test.ts:657–672 verifies that the delayed release fails, overwrite is refused and the seal commits the live held generation. verify.log:808 records this regression passing, :815 the rebase controls and :572 the database guards. These files are unchanged since the previous accepted review.
findings.reproduction: The retained regression pauses failed-seal cleanup beyond its claim bound, completes a retry, places a new seal's hold, then resumes the original release. It receives PRECONDITION_FAILED; overwrite receives OBJECT_HELD.

findings.title: Excluded hidden columns remain excluded from projection counts
findings.detail: FIXED. Only counted cells enter the projection lookup; lines 215–217 reject projection references to excluded hidden columns. packages/data-plane/test/selection-evaluation.test.ts:382–399 checks hidden-key and hidden-field refusals, formula-policy controls and a visible-column positive control. verify.log:659 records the regression passing. The implementation and regression are unchanged since the previous accepted review.
findings.reproduction: Projecting an excluded hidden column fails PROJECTION_COLUMN_HIDDEN. Including it enforces the formula policy; projecting the visible column succeeds.

findings.detail: FIXED. Agency-paged discovery finds lapsed cancellation secrets and invokes cleanup at line 66. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:246–248 purges the secret after its horizon without calling the provider or inventing cancellation confirmation. apps/control/test/storage-lifecycle.test.ts:333–335 checks retained UNCERTAIN status, secret removal and no further provider call; lines 348–352 check pagination past previously cleaned agencies. verify.log:824 records the regression passing.
